crossRefs.note: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites…
They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this…
I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field…
then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all…
Manasseh didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants…
When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.
Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: Yet the children of Manasseh couldn’t drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
translations.bsb: But the descendants of Manasseh were unable to occupy these cities, because the Canaanites were determined to stay in this land.
translations.kjv: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
